name: When should I choose cabinet painting instead of replacing my kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: When should I choose cabinet painting instead of replacing my kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet painting is ideal if your current cabinet boxes and doors are structurally sound, well-aligned, and you are satisfied with your existing kitchen layout. Painting updates the visual style, brightens the room, and covers outdated wood stains at a fraction of the cost of total replacement. However, if your cabinet boxes suffer from deep water damage, warped frames, broken face frames, or if you want to completely rearrange your kitchen floor plan, full replacement is the better choice. Evaluating whether your layout meets your daily household needs helps you decide between cosmetic refinishing and a broader kitchen remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint your cabinets if the boxes and doors are structurally sound and you like your kitchen layout. Replace them if you have water damage, structural warping, or want a new room design.
